Mindfulness Workshop
On January 15th, Student Health Services
is offering a 2-hour workshop on
mindfulness-based stress reduction.
Mindfulness meditation has been shown
to improve sleep, concentration, and memory,
and to reduce anxiety. Participants will learn about
and practice simple meditation techniques.
A follow-up weekly group meditation practice will be
offered throughout the semester.
